mainEntity.name: What is the cost of employee attrition?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is the estimated financial cost associated with departures and replacement, including recruitment, training and relevant vacancy expenses.

mainEntity.name: Is attrition cost the same as recruitment cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Recruitment cost is one component of the broader attrition cost estimate.

mainEntity.name: Can the calculator be used for factory workers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Employers can enter assumptions relevant to their workforce and operational environment.

mainEntity.name: Does the result represent an exact financial loss?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It is a model based on user-provided inputs and assumptions.
